journey.name: DMs, 24h Notes, and Messaging Features
journey.description: Tests the DMs tab, sharing and clearing a 24h Note with mood emoji, and checking DM conversation list or chat interaction when peers are present.

actions.action: Verify that the 'Notes (24h)' bar and 'Your Note' bubble are visible
Tap 'Your Note' to open the 'Share a 24h Note' dialog
Enter 'Testing by the pier' into the note text field and tap 'Share'
Verify that 'Testing by the pier' is visible on 'Your Note' bubble
Tap 'Your Note', tap 'Clear Note', and verify the note resets to 'Note...'
Check if any peer conversations are listed; if a peer is available, open the chat, verify the 'Disappearing messages timer' icon, and send a message
